text:
maria: Quick sync — we're building an Observability Starter Pack for the SI hardware partner and a cloud marketplace tile. Goal: one-click bundle that installs an OTLP collector (airgapped option), preloaded Datadog dashboards, and trace/span mapping for model inference. Need owners for: dashboard authoring, OTEL collector packaging, trace schema, marketplace listing copy, and legal/embargo. Can we do a short plan + timeline? :calendar:

jamal: +1. For trace schema I'd propose spans include: model.name, model.version, request.id, shard.id, seq_len, tokens.generated. Sampling: default 1% but keep error traces and latency p99. I'll draft a spec at https://tiny.redwood/obs-spec

jamal: Example OTLP collector config we can ship (airgap fallback -> file exporter):
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: "https://api.datadoghq.com"
    api_key: "${DD_API_KEY}"
  file:
    path: "/var/log/otlp/export.json"
processors:
  batch:
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```

kai: Runtime notes — emit model.* as span attributes from the inference service. Avoid per-token attributes (costly). Emit token counts and latency buckets. For GPU-affinity use service.instance.id or telemetry.shard. Instrument async to avoid blocking main loop.

olivia: PM checklist — marketing copy, install + admin docs, screenshots of dashboards, partner announcement timeline. Proposed partner beta: two weeks from now (2750009000). Legal needs signoff by 2750008500. Who can commit to the docs?

maria: Owners proposal: jamal -> trace schema + collector config; kai -> SDK + instrumentation; olivia -> GTM + docs + partner comms; maria -> marketplace listing + partner ops. datadog-integration-bot — can you upload packaged dashboards and confirm asset path?

datadog-integration-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-partnerships/obs-starter-pack/2750001111-dd-dashboard.tar.gz (sha256: abc123def456)

kai: Quick smoke steps:
1) install collector package (local)
2) start infer service (dev build)
3) run: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
4) check traces in Datadog (search tag model.name:demo-model)

jamal: E2E test for airgapped: configure file exporter, run load, confirm file contains span with attributes model.name and request.id. Sample trace push for local debugging:
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4318/v1/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @sample-trace.json

maria: I'll schedule 30m sync Thu 10am PT and create the GH tracking ticket. If anyone has blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
